description: Most websites break GDPR before visitors even click "Accept" — analytics and ad pixels that fire before consent are the #1 violation regulators' automated crawlers catch. GDPR Fix runs the same audit regulators do: it loads your site in a real headless browser and captures every cookie before, during, and after consent.
